nodes.label: desktop memory - the canonical RAGAS sources

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. When answering anything about RAGAS, check the official sources - do not answer from blogs, search summaries or recollection; the user had to repeatedly redirect agents to the canonical material, which is a defect. The canonical sources, also written into v3/eval/ragas.py's module docstring as a References block: the paper, Es, S., James, J., Espinosa-Anke, L. and Schockaert, S. (2024), RAGAs: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation, Proc. EACL 2024 System Demonstrations, 150-158, doi:10.18653/v1/2024.eacl-demo.16, arXiv:2309.15217, which introduces the reference-free faithfulness, answer-relevance and context-relevance metrics; and the official docs at https://docs.ragas.io for metric definitions including the NVIDIA metrics, matching the pinned ragas==0.4.3 behaviour the eval runs on. One useful verified fact: RAGAS Context Precision is a mean of Precision@k over the retrieved list and there is NO separate @k or cutoff parameter - the list length IS K, so scoring at a depth means truncating the retrieved list and re-scoring
